question: Should OpenClaw add bundled dashboard log-tail and command-output widgets now, and what redaction, permission, retention, export, and command-binding boundaries must those widgets follow?
rationale: The request is plausible and aligned with dashboard ergonomics, but it exposes operational logs and command output in a new always-visible UI surface and depends on unresolved dashboard substrate and binding decisions.

options.title: Stage After Substrate And Binding Review
options.body: Keep this issue open, settle the Wave 1 dashboard substrate and the stream/command binding security model first, then implement the widgets against approved contracts.

options.title: Narrow To Read-Only Existing Data
options.body: Allow a focused implementation only for existing `logs.tail` and already-recorded command-output data, excluding new command execution or generic command bindings.

options.title: Defer Bundled Dashboard Builtins
options.body: Leave this as roadmap context until maintainers sponsor bundled dashboard widgets or decide the capability should live outside core.

recommendation.title: Stage After Substrate And Binding Review
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, settle the Wave 1 dashboard substrate and the stream/command binding security model first, then implement the widgets against approved contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest current-main and merged-PR routing signal for the plugin-tab Control UI seam the dashboard would reuse.
